title: OperationOutcomeParams
description: Params for operation.outcome: the identity a mutating call carried on its request frame (ADR-8eej3e66 §4). The identity is opaque text the backend never parses; it names one mutation, minted by the renderer, and the answer is what the backend retained about it.

mutation.description: The mutation identity the call carried. 1 to 128 bytes of valid UTF-8 with no control characters.
